2608.09119.title: Motif 3: Technical Report
2608.09119.paper_summary: We introduce Motif 3, a decoder-only Mixture-of-Experts language model with 314 billion total parameters and 13.2 billion activated per token. Each sparse MoE layer contains 384 routed experts, with eight selected per token. This fine-grained sparsity provides substantial expert capacity while limiting computation. Motif 3 is built around Grouped Differential Latent Attention (GDLA), which integrates grouped differential attention with the compressed key-value representation of Multi-head Latent Attention. The architecture further incorporates modified manifold-constrained hyper-connections, Expert Specific PolyNorm activations, and multi-token prediction to improve optimization stability, expert specialization, and inference efficiency. We pretrain Motif 3 on approximately 12.5 trillion tokens spanning web documents, STEM, code, mathematics, multilingual content, and domain-specialized corpora. Expert-balancing and numerical-stabilization techniques support stable training at scale, while selective MXFP8 computation and communication, memory-efficient fused kernels, and window-aware context parallelism enable training with context lengths up to 256K tokens. Our post-training pipeline combines general supervised fine-tuning, six specialist teachers trained with reinforcement learning, a software-engineering teacher trained with supervised fine-tuning, and Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation. The resulting unified model consolidates complementary capabilities in reasoning, coding, tool use, professional work, long-context understanding, calibrated abstention, and instruction following. Across a broad evaluation suite, Motif 3 demonstrates competitive performance against leading open weight models, including strong results on long-horizon agentic tasks, mathematical reasoning, scientific knowledge, and hallucination-sensitive evaluation.
2608.09119.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹Motif 3，一個僅解碼的專家混合語言模型，擁有3140億總參數和每個標記激活的132億參數。每個稀疏的MoE層包含384個路由專家，每個標記選擇八個專家。這種細粒度的稀疏性提供了可觀的專家容量，同時限制了計算量。Motif 3圍繞分組微分潛在注意力（GDLA）構建，該方法將分組微分注意力與多頭潛在注意力的壓縮鍵值表示相結合。該架構進一步整合了修改過的流形約束超連接、專家特定的PolyNorm激活和多標記預測，以提高優化穩定性、專家專業化和推理效率。我們在約12.5萬億個標記上預訓練Motif 3，這些標記涵蓋了網頁文件、STEM、代碼、數學、多語言內容和領域專門的語料庫。專家平衡和數值穩定技術支持大規模穩定訓練，而選擇性MXFP8計算和通信、內存高效的融合內核以及窗口感知上下文並行性使得訓練能夠處理長達256K標記的上下文長度。我們的後訓練流程結合了通用的監督微調、六位專家教師的強化學習訓練、一位通過監督微調訓練的軟體工程教師以及多教師在政策蒸餾。最終的統一模型整合了推理、編碼、工具使用、專業工作、長上下文理解、校準的棄權和遵循指令的互補能力。在廣泛的評估套件中，Motif 3在與領先的開放權重模型的競爭中表現出色，包括在長期代理任務、數學推理、科學知識和敏感幻覺評估方面的強勁結果。
